newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LYNAGH INJURED PLAYING FOR ENGLISH CLUB.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LYNAGH INJURED PLAYING FOR ENGLISH CLUB.

text.p: Australian World Cup captain Michael Lynagh could be out of rugby union action for up to three months after dislocating his shoulder in a match for his English club Saracens on Sunday.
Lynagh sustained the injury in a 36-21 defeat by Wasps when he was dumped by England international Lawrence Dallaglio with the score at 6-6.
Lynagh, reputed to be earning 100,000 pounds sterling ($150,000) a season, has played just over 100 minutes for Saracens.
Saracens coach Mark Evans said Lynagh would be out for between three weeks and three months. "He is worth every penny we are paying him and it is a damaging blow for us," Evans said.
